## It’s time to Start Flipping Tables.
## James
James is an eighth-generation Texan, former middle school teacher, and Presbyterian seminarian. As a state representative, he’s led the fight against the billionaire mega-donors and puppet politicians who have taken over Texas.
Now, he’s running for U.S. Senate to take his fight against corruption to Washington and win power back for working people.
We’re going up against billionaire mega-donors, a rigged system, and a whole lot of money. Pitch in now to help power this movement.
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.
It will take all of us to win this fight — neighbor talking to neighbor. Join our volunteer team today to help us reach Texans in every community.

## Corruption & Democracy
Getting Big Money Out of Politics
Politics feels corrupt because it is. James Talarico hasn’t taken a dime of corporate PAC money since his first race in 2017. His anti-corruption agenda bans super PACs and corporate PACs, bans stock trading by members of Congress, and closes billionaire tax loopholes.
Politics feels corrupt because it is.
Billionaire mega-donors aren’t just buying yachts and jets — they’re buying power, and they’re using that power to rig our political system.
Billionaires and their giant corporations pour millions of dollars into campaign contributions and corporate PACs to elect politicians who will do their bidding. In return, they get tax loopholes that save themselves money — and the government makes up for the lost revenue by raising taxes on the rest of us or slashing the programs we’ve paid into.
- Our schools are being defunded — so billionaires can get another tax break.
- Our health premiums are going up — so billionaires can get another tax break.
- Our Social Security benefits are constantly under threat — so billionaires can get yet another tax break.
Then the politicians who engage in this corruption try to shield themselves from accountability by gerrymandering our political maps and making it harder for us to vote. They get rich off their offices through insider trading, and they cover up each other’s crimes just like they’ve done with the Epstein files.
It’s time to end this broken political system.
Billionaires aren’t just buying yachts and jets — they’re buying power, and they’re using that power to rig our political system.
That’s why I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money . It’s why I broke quorum twice with my colleagues in the Texas House to fight back against rigged redistricting maps and defend the freedom to vote. And it’s why the first set of legislation I will pursue in the U.S. Senate will be an anti-corruption package to ban super PACs and corporate PACs, ban partisan gerrymandering, and increase transparency and accountability in all branches of government.
Because making progress on every other issue we care about — whether it’s health care, education, or the cost of living — comes down to getting dark money out of our politics and making sure government is accountable to us .

They own the media.

That is corruption of the highest order. pic.twitter.com/mc5jVyPjkA
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) October 9, 2025
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Get Big Money out of our politics: Reverse the impact of the Supreme Court’s Citizens United ruling, including by banning super PACs and corporate PACs.
- Ban partisan gerrymandering nationwide: Establish independent redistricting commissions so that voters can choose their politicians — not the other way around.
- Make it easier for citizens to participate in our elections: Pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to remove unnecessary barriers to registering to vote and casting a ballot.
- Ban Congressional stock trading: Ban Members of Congress from trading individual stocks, engaging in insider trading, and profiting from their positions.
- Institute term limits on Members of Congress: Implement term limits of six two-year terms in the House and two six-year terms in the Senate to bring new perspectives to Congress and prevent entrenched, career politicians who are not accountable to their constituents.
- Require Members of Congress to hold annual town halls: Ensure officials are listening and responding to their constituents through yearly town halls in their district.
- Ban presidential pardons: Eliminate the broad power of presidential pardons that has been abused by presidents on both sides of the aisle.
- Increase accountability for the Supreme Court: Implement term limits and a binding code of conduct for U.S. Supreme Court justices, including mandating rules for recusals, financial disclosures, and limitations on accepting gifts.
- Increase oversight and improve ethics at all levels of government: Defend against government efforts to ignore court rulings or dismantle checks and balances, and only confirm judicial appointees who meet the highest ethical standards and commit to upholding the Constitution.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Never taken a dime of corporate PAC money since my very first race for the Texas House in 2017.
- Authored legislation to combat corrupt politics through establishing campaign contribution caps on state-level candidates and creating an I ndependent Citizen Redistricting Commission to end partisan gerrymandering in Texas.
- Broke quorum twice in the Texas House to fight back against partisan redistricting power grabs and defend the freedom to vote.
- Made elections and voting information more accessible by requiring counties to post notice of election information on their websites.

pages.title: James Talarico on Energy, the Texas Grid & Utility Bills
pages.text:
## Energy & Environment
A Reliable Grid and Lower Energy Bills
Will the Texas grid hold this winter? James Talarico will weatherproof the grid, lower electric bills, and keep Texas the world’s energy leader with an all-of-the-above strategy that protects good-paying oil and gas jobs and grows wind, solar, and geothermal.
Texas is the state that put a man on the moon. We’re the state that pioneered ranching, computers, and modern energy. If any state can figure out how to grow our economy, lower costs, and combat climate change, it’s Texas.
We’re the energy leader of the world — and as Senator, I will work tirelessly to ensure our state not only maintains, but extends that innovative leadership for generations to come so that Texans always have access to reliable, affordable energy.
If we invest in innovation, we can add to our hundreds of thousands of oil, gas, wind, solar, and battery jobs by creating new jobs in cutting-edge technologies like geothermal and hydrogen-fueled energy. We can pioneer innovative ways to streamline permitting processes without compromising the protection of our environment — so that Texas can lead in increasing energy supply and driving down costs.
I will work tirelessly to ensure our state not only maintains, but extends that innovative leadership for generations to come.
And we can better prepare for climate disasters instead of constantly being caught flat-footed when they hit our state. Just in the last decade, Texans have faced historic droughts, devastating wildfires, multiple “500-year” floods, and one of the deadliest winter storms in our state’s history — which killed hundreds of our fellow Texans. That kind of incompetence in the face of increasingly frequent climate disasters is completely unacceptable — and I will do everything in my power to ensure Texans never face the consequences of that level of unpreparedness ever again.
This new war in Venezuela is deeply corrupt.
I will never vote to send someone’s son or daughter to war to make oil executives richer. pic.twitter.com/wxBD9B60dS
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) January 5, 2026
Gas prices are surging because of this new war in Iran.
I’m calling for a suspension of the federal gas tax — which would immediately drop the price of gas by 18 cents a gallon.
Suspend the gas tax. End the war in Iran. Make life more affordable. pic.twitter.com/HQ5rQ8c6I2
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) April 30, 2026
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Make energy more available, reliable, and affordable in Texas: Reinstate federal tax credits, loans, and other tools that diversify energy production and accelerate renewable energy development; streamline permitting processes for energy projects without compromising environmental protections; and make gasoline more affordable by investing in pipeline fortification and building supply chains for critical minerals and transformers.
- Provide emergency relief for Texas families struggling to pay their energy bills: Expand funding and eligibility for the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP), which helps families pay their utility bills during times when energy costs are spiking.
- Protect Texans from future increases in energy costs: Require large energy users like AI data centers to cover the cost of the energy infrastructure updates they need so those costs aren’t passed onto consumers; crack down on energy price gouging during natural disasters and other emergencies; and modernize the LIHEAP disbursement formula to ensure that hot climate states — like Texas — receive equitable funds to help families with utility costs.
- Create jobs and grow our energy workforce: Add to Texas’ hundreds of thousands of oil, gas, wind, and solar jobs by creating good-paying jobs for cutting-edge projects like geothermal and hydrogen-fueled energy, as well as finishing the job of plugging abandoned oil and gas wells. Maintain Texas’ energy leadership by establishing more job training and Registered Apprenticeship programs focused on energy engineering, manufacturing, and construction.
- Protect the air we breathe and the water we drink: Prioritize strengthening the Clean Air Act and the Clean Water Act.
- Prepare for extreme weather events and support those impacted by them: Cut red tape so more Texans can benefit from the Department of Energy’s Weatherization Assistance Program, expand eligibility for FEMA’s Pre-Disaster Mitigation Program to help fortify at-risk homes and businesses, and more effectively provide assistance after disasters like Hurricane Harvey instead of leaving families in crisis.
- Strengthen the Texas energy grid: Dedicate greater federal resources to help Texas weatherproof our power grid and update aging infrastructure, without letting energy companies off the hook for contributing their fair share.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Improved the reliability of the Texas power grid by requiring an annual independent audit of weaknesses in grid infrastructure.
- Responded to the climate crisis by authoring legislation to create the Texas Climate Action Act to marshal the resources of our state government to fight climate change.
- Strengthened Texas’ response to climate hazards by appropriating funds for disaster relief and preparedness .
- Advocated for safer environments for our kids by authoring legislation to remove lead from school water fountains and improve air filtration efficiency standards in schools.
- Improved every community’s access to water by appropriating up to $1 billion to provide stable, annual funding to support water infrastructure development and upkeep.

pages.title: James Talarico on Foreign Policy, Iran & Israel
pages.text:
## Foreign Policy
Strong Alliances, No More Forever Wars
For Texans, foreign policy isn’t foreign. James Talarico will end the forever war in Iran that’s driving up the cost of gas and groceries, keep Iran from getting a nuclear weapon, stand with our allies, and lead with moral clarity.
Texas has the eighth-largest economy in the world, exporting more goods to foreign nations than any other state. We share the country’s largest border with Mexico. And we’re home to the largest number of veterans who have served across the globe.
For Texans, foreign policy isn’t foreign.
I was 12 years old on September 11, 2001 — I know the importance of keeping our country safe. As a millennial, I also saw how military disasters like the Iraq War robbed America of young lives, trillions of dollars, and our moral standing across the globe.
I will reject efforts to shut America off from the rest of the world — because I know it makes us weaker and less secure. I’m committed to working in partnership with our foreign allies and engaging in diplomacy that will help us prevent attacks on American soil and avoid unnecessary wars.
It is our duty as the world’s oldest democracy to defend Ukraine against Russian aggression, address human rights abuses like those being suffered by the people of Sudan, and use every ounce of our diplomatic and financial leverage to secure peace in Israel and Palestine.
My north star will always be to protect innocent life. October 7th was the deadliest day for Jews since the Holocaust — and Israel has the right to defend its people. But Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu does not have the right to bomb civilians, restrict aid, or use forced famine and collective punishment as tactics. With tens of thousands of civilians killed and unimaginable human suffering in Gaza, America must lead with moral clarity and prevent any U.S. funds from being used to harm civilians.
As U.S. Senator, I will do everything in my power to ensure America always leads with moral clarity in its approach to foreign policy. Not only is it the right thing to do — but it will make America stronger, richer, and safer.
.@JamesTalarico: As a millennial, I saw how military disasters like the Iraq war robbed this nation of young lives, of billions of dollars, and of our moral standing in the world. I worry this administration is making the same mistake with another forever war.
We’re always told… pic.twitter.com/WCBJdHYE98
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) March 20, 2026
.@JamesTalarico: As a millennial, I saw how military disasters like the Iraq war robbed this nation of young lives, billions of dollars, and our moral standing.
Every dollar we spend bombing people in the Middle East is a dollar we are not spending in communities like Sand… pic.twitter.com/vbXCwjYS6B
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) March 10, 2026
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Keep Iran from getting a nuclear weapon — without another forever war: Find an end to this disastrous war that ensures Iran does not develop a nuclear weapon, supports the democracy movement, and stops costing American taxpayers hundreds of billions of dollars.
- Serve the veterans who have served all of us: Stand against efforts to privatize the VA, reverse the Trump Administration’s mass terminations of federal veteran employees, and ensure veterans have access to housing, job training, career opportunities, and real pathways to stability when they come home.
- Repeal unnecessary tariffs and support responsible trade: Roll back the Trump Administration’s tariff policies that are raising costs for American consumers and hurting Texas business owners, reject actions that risk escalating trade wars, and support trade partnerships that include strong protections for American workers.
- Deepen cooperation with NATO, the EU, and other allies: Encourage more — not less — cooperation with our foreign allies as a means to promote human rights, build more resilient supply chains to combat inflation, prevent nuclear proliferation, and protect America’s interests both at home and abroad.
- Restore investments in diplomacy and international development: Ensure the State Department is fully funded and staffed, reverse the unlawful dismantling of the U.S. Agency for International Development, and restore investments in programs that combat violence, famine, disease, and human suffering — recognizing that these investments are strategic to America’s interests.
- Take urgent action to support peace in the Middle East: Protect innocent life by stopping offensive weapons sales to the Netanyahu government while supporting defensive systems like the Iron Dome alongside agreements that American funds will not be used to harm civilians; use all of America’s financial and diplomatic leverage to secure a two-state solution that disarms Hamas, establishes a democratic Palestinian state, halts Israel’s illegal settlements, and respects the sovereignty of both nations; and promote long-term regional cooperation to defend American interests against adversaries like Iran.
- Ensure Ukraine remains free and independent: Support measures that enable America, Ukraine, and our European partners to negotiate from a position of strength to ensure Ukraine’s long-term security, protect the stability of Europe, and hold Russia accountable for the cost of its aggression.
- Stand up for human rights: Use our international influence to defend persecuted people around the world, including by taking action to stop human rights abuses, such as those suffered by the Uyghurs, Rohingya, and Sudanese.
## Join Our fight to Take Power back for working People.

pages.title: James Talarico on Freedom, Family & Faith

## Freedom, Family & Faith
Personal Freedom, Working Families, and Religious Liberty
James Talarico is a Christian and a Presbyterian seminarian whose faith is guided by two commandments: love God and love your neighbor. He defends the separation of church and state, opposes book bans and the Texas THC ban, and fights for paid family leave and affordable child care.
Politicians like John Cornyn and Ken Paxton claim to stand for freedom, family, and faith.
- But you can’t stand for freedom and control what we say, what we read, and what we do with our own bodies.
- You can’t stand for family and vote against paid family leave, affordable child care, or the right of every American to marry who they love.
- And you can’t stand for faith and then warp and weaponize religion to hurt our neighbors.
I’m a Presbyterian seminarian studying to become a pastor. My faith in Jesus leads me to reject Christian Nationalism and commit myself to the project of democracy. Because that’s the promise of America: a democracy where every person and every family — regardless of religion, race, gender, sexual orientation, or any other difference between us — can truly be free and live up to their full potential.
It’s time to elect a Senator who will actually fight for freedom, family, and faith — one who will stand up for the freedoms of every Texan, make it easier to start and care for a family, and defend the separation of church and state.

## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Oppose censorship and protect the freedom of speech: Oppose book banning and cancel culture, pass the No Political Enemies Act to protect individuals and organizations from being targeted by the government for exercising their freedom of speech, and defend the freedom of the press.
- Get government out of Americans’ private personal decisions: Restore reproductive freedom with federal legislation to codify Roe v. Wade and protect access to contraception and IVF, protect the legality of gay marriage and defend our LGBTQ+ neighbors from government overreach, and legalize regulated marijuana for adults so that we no longer put people behind bars for a substance that is already legal in half the country.
- Make it easier to start and raise a family: Expand the Child Tax Credit to help families with the cost of raising children, pass paid family leave legislation that would allow Americans to take time off work to bond with a new child or care for a seriously ill family member, and expand access to affordable child care so that no parent has to choose between continuing their career and starting a family.
- Make it easier for families to care for their aging loved ones: Increase access to eldercare by passing the Older Americans Act Reauthorization Act to expand affordable home- and community-based care for seniors, and prioritize the development of a high-quality elder care workforce.
- Defend the separation of church and state and continue to speak out against those who twist the meaning of faith to hurt our neighbors: Pass the Do No Harm Act to protect religious liberty and prevent religious discrimination; take vigorous action against antisemitism, Islamophobia, and other faith-based hate crimes; and reject policies that force religion into neutral public spaces like schools, prisons, courts, and the military.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Killed legislation that would have established a statewide book ban and removed classic literature like Lonesome Dove and The Catcher in the Rye in public schools by using a procedural point of order on the floor of the Texas House.
- Stood up to Texas Republicans’ proposed THC ban , calling out how it would infringe on individual liberty, hurt veterans, and empower the cartels.
- Made high-quality childcare more accessible and affordable by establishing property tax exemptions for child care providers and increasing the supply of high-quality centers.
- Made progress toward universal paid family leave in Texas by establishing a regulatory framework for family leave insurance policies issued by employers.
- Supported young families by providing a liaison officer at each campus of higher education to connect student-parents with health care, employment, transportation, and academic success services.
- Authored legislation to legalize regulated marijuana for adults in Texas and use the new tax revenue to fund child care and early childhood education.
- Defended the separation of church and state by leading the fight against legislation to force the Ten Commandments into public school classrooms, replace school counselors with untrained religious chaplains, and infuse Bible stories into public school curriculum.

pages.title: James Talarico on Health Care & Prescription Drug Costs
pages.text:
## Health Care
Lower Costs and Coverage Texans Can Count On
James Talarico capped insulin at $25 a month in Texas and got it through a Republican legislature. In the Senate, he’ll protect Texans’ health insurance and Medicaid, lower drug costs and medical debt, and end Texas’ maternal mortality crisis.
When I was 28 years old, I almost died.
I was running in my first race for the Texas House. I decided to walk the entire length of my district — 25 miles in one day — holding town halls along the way. I wasn’t worried about my ability to finish the walk — I hike Big Bend every year!
But about halfway through, I started feeling nauseous and fatigued. I threw up a couple of times on the way, but figured I was just dehydrated. Somehow, I finished.
When I got home, I slept for 36 hours. My family rushed me to the ER, where nurses checked my blood sugar. I was immediately diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. I was in diabetic ketoacidosis, which ends in coma and death without insulin.
When I got out of the ICU, I went to Walgreens to pick up my first 30-day supply of insulin. It cost me $684. I didn’t have that kind of money (most Texans don’t, either) — so I put it on a credit card. I later learned that it costs companies only $10 per vial to produce insulin, but Big Pharma boosts profits by price gouging.
It’s time to take our fight for guaranteed health care to our nation’s capital.
So when I got elected, I passed bills that capped insulin copays at $25 a month and allowed Texas to import cheaper prescription drugs from Canada at a fraction of what they cost in the U.S. due to price gouging by Big Pharma.
But there’s so much more to do. Republicans in DC just passed the largest transfer of wealth in American history with their “Big Ugly Bill.” They slashed Medicaid and Medicare, are kicking 15 million people off their health insurance, and raised premiums for millions more — all to give yet another tax break for billionaires.
It’s time to take our fight for guaranteed health care to our nation’s capital and finally put the lives of Americans over the profits of billionaire mega-donors and special interests.
Because health care is a human right.
You need to hear this.

## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Allow every American — regardless of their age — to join Medicare: Provide an affordable not-for-profit health care option for every American, while also bringing down costs for those who don’t participate by increasing competition with private insurance.
- Break up Big Medicine: Support bipartisan antitrust legislation to stop vertically integrated health-care conglomerates, including pharmacy benefit managers, insurance companies, big hospital networks, and other healthcare monopolies that put profit above the well-being of patients.
- Lower prescription drug costs: Increase price transparency and negotiating power to ensure fair pricing, incentivize the development and approval of generic drugs, institute caps on out-of-pocket costs, and regulate pharmacy benefit managers to ensure they’re not up-charging patients.
- Protect health coverage and lower premiums: Protect and improve the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and reverse the Trump Administration’s dangerous cuts to the ACA enhanced tax credits, Medicare, and Medicaid that will kick 15 million Americans off their insurance and raise premiums for millions more.
- Reform the prior authorization system: Ensure that insurance companies do not arbitrarily deny patients the medication and treatments that their health care providers have determined necessary.
- Restore access to reproductive health care in Texas: Codify Roe v. Wade and protect access to contraception and IVF so that families can get the reproductive care they need and so that women are no longer dying needlessly due to Texas’ dangerous abortion ban.
- Save rural hospitals: Prioritize recruiting and retaining rural health care workers, improve Medicaid and Medicare reimbursement rates to more swiftly deliver payments to hospitals, and make sure rural hospitals have the funding they need to continue to serve as vital employers and health care providers.
- Protect Americans from crippling medical debt: Cancel eligible medical debt and stop hospitals and insurance companies from overcharging patients, regulate medical debt collection practices, bar the inclusion of medical debt in credit scores, and increase transparency and public reporting of both medical billing practices and the allocation of financial assistance provided by hospitals so Texans no longer go into debt when they get sick.
- Ensure veterans have access to the services they’ve earned: Stand against efforts to privatize the VA, and fund the agency to ensure every veteran receives the quality care they need.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Lowered prescription drug costs by capping insulin co-pays at $25 a month in Texas, allowing Texas to import cheaper prescription drugs from Canada at reduced costs, cracking down on Big Pharma for price-gouging , and establishing a prescription drug savings program for uninsured Texans.
- Held health insurance companies accountable by cracking down on surprise billings for emergency care and banning insurance companies from steering patients to hospitals that overcharge for services .
- Brought down health insurance premiums by regulating anticompetitive consolidation practices that health care and insurance companies use to inflate prices.
- Protected rural hospitals by approving the establishment of the State Office of Rural Hospital Finance and the Texas Rural Hospital Officers Academy.
- Combatted the health care worker shortage by offering tuition and fee exemptions for emergency medical students .
- Increased access to medical marijuana for adults by expanding patient eligibility and establishing a compassionate use review board .
- Protected Medicaid access for thousands of Texans by using a procedural point of order on the floor of the Texas house to kill legislation that would have kicked people off their coverage.
- Supported veterans’ mental health by directing Texas agencies to research alternative therapies for post-traumatic stress disorder.
## Join Our fight to Take Power back for working People.

pages.title: James Talarico on Immigration & Border Security
pages.text:
## Immigration & Border Security
Secure the Border, Fix the System
James Talarico believes our border should have a welcome mat out front and a lock on the door. His plan, endorsed by a Republican sheriff, hires more Border Patrol agents, cracks down on the cartels, and passes comprehensive immigration reform to fix a broken system.
I’m an eighth-generation Texan. My family has been here since it was Mexico. We have deep ties to the border — my mother grew up in Laredo, and much of our family still lives there. We Texans understand immigration better than most Americans — both its challenges and its benefits.
Most of us agree on what should happen. Our border should be like a front porch — it should have a welcome mat out front and a lock on the door. We can both welcome the stranger — refugees, asylum seekers, and folks who want to contribute to our economy and pursue the American dream — and we can keep people out who mean to do us harm.
We should be cracking down on the cartels, not our communities. We should be deporting gang members, not small business owners. We should be hunting down human traffickers, not moms and babies. We should be stopping illegal immigration, not curtailing avenues for immigrants to legally migrate to America and make our country richer and stronger.
Our border should be like a front porch — it should have a welcome mat out front and a lock on the door.
Texans should be the ones to lead our country in finally pursuing comprehensive immigration reforms that keep us safe, live up to our values and shared humanity, and supercharge our economy. Imagine having a U.S. Senator from Texas who will take the charge to get that done.
ICE should be cracking down on the cartels, not our communities.
ICE should be deporting gang members, not small business owners.
ICE should be hunting down human traffickers, not moms and babies. pic.twitter.com/zOSbfusNAj
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) November 17, 2025
.@JamesTalarico: I think we should all come together and finally pass comprehensive immigration reform.
We should finally fix this problem instead of grandstanding on it. pic.twitter.com/lpMK47rStZ
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) January 6, 2026
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Pass comprehensive immigration reform: Secure the border, make it easier to come here legally, and supercharge our economy.
- Focus ICE resources on improving public safety and national security: Prioritize the deportation of criminals, gang members, and human traffickers — not our neighbors who contribute to our communities, pay taxes, and pose no threat to our safety.
- Hold ICE accountable for abuses: Ban ICE agents from wearing masks or refusing to show identification, and hold them accountable when they break the law.
- Create pathways to legalization for certain undocumented immigrants: Create a path to citizenship for the immigrants who have been here the longest and certain groups like spouses and DREAMers, while allowing those who recently arrived to apply for temporary work permits if they are filling a job that will help lower costs for Americans.
- Modernize ports of entry to better detect threats before they enter the country: Develop and deploy cutting-edge X-Ray and other technologies to better detect drugs at ports of entry, where over 90% of the fentanyl comes into the country.
- Reform the asylum system: Hire more immigration judges to clear the asylum backlog, root out fraud in the system so that only legitimate claims are approved, and ensure legitimate asylees receive protection quickly.
- Create an employer sponsorship program focused specifically on lowering costs for Americans: Make it easier for businesses (particularly small businesses) to hire migrant workers in sectors like housing construction and agriculture to reduce labor shortages, address supply chain issues, and lower inflation.
- Improve standards on guest worker visas: Ensure strong labor standards on guest worker visas and crack down on employers who game the system to exploit immigrants or displace American workers and suppress their wages.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Authored legislation to increase security at ports of entry by installing advanced X-Ray inspection technology systems at Texas-Mexico border crossings.
- Supported landowners along the border by voting for legislation to compensate them for damage to their agricultural property caused by illegal border crossings.
- Fought against legislation that would increase racial profiling and decrease trust between communities and law enforcement.
- Strengthened border operations by approving an audit of strategies to strengthen border security, support law enforcement response efforts, maximize safety, reduce traffic congestion, and enhance infrastructure and road technology.
- Approved the creation of a grant program to reduce wait times for agricultural inspections at ports of entry so that we can process products more quickly without compromising security.
## Join Our fight to Take Power back for working People.

pages.title: James Talarico on Jobs, Wages & Small Business
pages.text:
## Labor & Business
Higher Wages and a Fair Shot for Small Businesses
Supporting workers and supporting small businesses go hand in hand. James Talarico will raise the minimum wage to $15, expand overtime, pass paid family leave, protect the freedom to unionize, and give small businesses a fair shot against giant corporations.
When my younger sister was born, she was 10 weeks premature and required around-the-clock care. Our mom didn’t have access to family leave, so while she was with my sister in the NICU, the hotel she worked at called her and fired her over the phone. So there she was — no job, mounting medical bills, and a baby struggling to survive.
Thankfully, my sister got better. But things have gotten worse for workers in this country.
We don’t have to choose between supporting workers and supporting businesses.
Workers and small businesses keep our economy running. But right now, the deck is stacked against them. Giant corporations get tax write-offs when their CEOs fly on private jets, while the average family is struggling to get by.
Billionaire mega-donors and their puppet politicians want you to believe that if we raise the minimum wage, support paid family leave, or allow workers to unionize, it’ll kill jobs and crush the economy. But the evidence doesn’t back that up.
We don’t have to choose between supporting workers and supporting businesses. Doing both is how we ensure hard work is rewarded and every American has the opportunity to earn their way into the middle class.
From my 100% pro-labor voting record to my leadership as Vice Chair of the Committee on Trade, Workforce, and Economic Development in the Texas House, I’ve spent my career fighting for workers, connecting Texans to more good-paying jobs, and making Texas the #1 place to start and grow a business.
James Talarico stopped at Takitos Con Sabor in Eagle Pass, TX🔥 pic.twitter.com/u4cCwxyJLz

Childcare is now more expensive than college.
In the Legislature, I passed a bill to cut property taxes for childcare centers, allowing small businesses like Green Space Nature Preschool to cut costs for working families.
In the Senate, I’ll keep fighting for our tiny Texans.… pic.twitter.com/Prd4Vpig3o

I just gave the commencement address at Paul Quinn College — the oldest HBCU in Texas.
I told them: “You have scrolled through more suffering, division, and chaos than any generation in human history.
But as painful as it may be, your disillusionment is a superpower." pic.twitter.com/B5z3KCSfHK

I joined the picket line with striking hotel workers in Houston.
If you put in the hours, you shouldn’t be scraping by.
I will never stop fighting for Texas workers in this economy rigged for billionaires. pic.twitter.com/wIF4Tf4zy6
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) September 16, 2025
Beat the billionaires.
Take power back for working people. https://t.co/3wzMFzC0lA pic.twitter.com/Z22xGojePa
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) September 16, 2025
Childcare is now more expensive than college tuition.
I just passed major legislation with Sen. West and Rep. Button to bring down childcare costs for working families.
This is what pro-family policy looks like. #txlege pic.twitter.com/840rQiXjdd
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) May 19, 2023
I was born to a single mom who worked long hours at a hotel.
Just days after giving birth to me, the hotel forced her to go back to work.
Today she joined me as I filed legislation to enact paid family leave for all Texans. pic.twitter.com/9t5k0aRo2N
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) February 14, 2023
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Raise wages and reward hard work: Raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour, expand overtime eligibility, and incentivize CEOs to pay fair wages by creating a special tax on corporations that pay their top executives more than 250 times their median worker’s salary. Implement tax credits and subsidies to help small- and medium-sized businesses adapt to a minimum wage raise without cutting jobs or hours.
- Even the playing field between giant corporations and small businesses: End the extreme tax breaks that allow the largest corporations to pay $0 in federal income taxes so that we can help more entrepreneurs make their dreams a reality. Expand support for Community Development Financial Institutions and community banks to increase access to credit and capital, broaden eligibility for Small Business Administration loan programs, and support states in providing more equity investment and technical assistance for small businesses.
- Protect the retirement benefits working people have earned: Fight tooth and nail against attacks on Social Security and Medicare, ensure the wealthiest Americans pay their fair share into Social Security by eliminating the tax cap on those earning over $400,000 a year, and incentivize employer-sponsored pensions.
- Ensure AI works for working people: Protect workers from invasive AI surveillance in the workplace; use AI to make jobs safer and less repetitive, rather than to eliminate them; create pathways for workers to move into higher-skilled, better-paying roles as the economy evolves; ensure AI companies follow the same copyright laws as everyone else; include worker voices in government-funded AI research and development, and defend the right to transparency and human review for automated decisionmaking around promotions, discipline, and terminations.
- Ensure no Texan has to choose between their career and their family: Pass paid family leave legislation that would allow Americans to take time off work to bond with a new child or care for a seriously ill family member, and expand access to affordable childcare (which helps businesses, too!).
- Support workers’ right to unionize: Pass the PRO Act so that all working people have the freedom to join together and negotiate with their employers for better wages and working conditions.
- Keep more jobs in Texas with fair trade policies, not counterproductive tariffs: Repeal the Trump Administration’s overly broad tariffs that are hurting consumers and businesses. Instead, advocate for and approve trade deal protections that prevent foreign competitors from undercutting American workers by exploiting weak labor laws abroad.
- Reduce labor shortages and bring down costs with smart immigration policies that don’t harm American workers: Make it easier for small businesses to hire migrant workers in sectors like housing construction and agriculture to reduce labor shortages, address supply chain issues, and lower costs. Ensure strong labor standards on those visas and crack down on employers who game the system to displace American workers or suppress their wages.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Reduced costs for small businesses by approving an increase in the business personal property tax exemption and the minimization of licensing and regulation fees for businesses in their first year of operation.
- Helped ensure families don’t have to choose between a career and their family by making high-quality childcare more accessible and affordable and establishing a regulatory framework for family leave insurance policies .
- Invested in the next generation of Texas workers by supporting an increase in Registered Apprenticeship programs and requiring local workforce boards to develop specific strategies to connect young people to workforce training and job opportunities .
- Made career and workforce training more affordable by creating tuition and fee exemptions , establishing the public junior college state finance program , and supporting the creation of the Lone Star Workforce of the Future Fund.
- Authored legislation to raise wages and support unions by increasing Texas’ minimum wage to $15 per hour , making Texas a Right to Organize state, and codifying overtime protections for workers .
- Made workplaces safer by supporting legislation to establish a workplace violence hotline, to strengthen the appeals process for investigators in child labor violation cases, and to clarify that sexual harassment in all workplaces is unlawful.

pages.title: James Talarico on Public Education & School Vouchers
pages.text:
## Public Education
A Former Teacher Fighting for Public Schools
James Talarico taught sixth grade on San Antonio’s West Side and led the fight against private school vouchers in the Texas House. He’ll keep public money in public schools, hire more teachers, raise teacher pay, and bring universal Pre-K to every Texas family.
Before I ran for office, I was a public school teacher. I taught 6th-grade language arts on the Westside of San Antonio — one of Texas’s poorest zip codes.
When I entered the classroom, the Texas Legislature had just gutted the public education budget by $5 billion — so I had 45 kids in one classroom. There weren’t enough desks for everyone, so some of my students sat on the air conditioning unit.
In the richest country on the planet, I knew that was unacceptable.
I’ve gone toe-to-toe with billionaires like Tim Dunn, Farris Wilks, and Betsy DeVos, who have been spending their fortunes attacking our neighborhood public schools.
My experience in the classroom is what drove me to run for public office. In each of my four terms in the Texas House of Representatives, I served on the Public Education Committee — partnering with parents, teachers, and students to increase teacher pay, improve early childhood education, expand career and technical education, and more.
Because of that commitment to public schools, my colleagues in the Texas House selected me to lead the fight against Governor Abbott’s private school voucher scam — a program that is taking tax dollars out of our public schools to subsidize private education, even for billionaires like Elon Musk. I’ve gone toe-to-toe with billionaires like Tim Dunn, Farris Wilks, and Betsy DeVos, who have been spending their fortunes attacking our neighborhood public schools.
As I see those same billionaires now partnering with DC Republicans to take their voucher scam nationwide and gut the U.S. Department of Education, I’m ready to take my fight to Washington and not only save our public schools — but make them the envy of the world so that every Texas child has a chance at success.
Texas Republicans are trying to force public schools to display the Ten Commandments in every classroom.
I told the bill author: “This bill is not only un-constitutional and un-American, it’s deeply un-Christian.” #txlege pic.twitter.com/TI7TmGvIKM
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) May 3, 2023
I started my career as a public school teacher on the westside of San Antonio.
Now I’m back as a candidate for the U.S. Senate.
This city taught me how to fight for working families — and I’m ready to take that fight to our nation’s capital. pic.twitter.com/y3dYJu9nRl

Pre-k is the most important grade.
But Texas has no limits on prekindergarten class size. Some classes have 30+ kids.

Now his school district requires Narcan—an overdose reversal medication—on each campus. It's already saved 5 lives.
I just passed a bill to put Narcan on EVERY school campus in Texas. #txlege pic.twitter.com/irOVIXTFrZ
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) May 26, 2023
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Boost reading and math achievement: Provide grants and other incentives to encourage public schools to adopt evidence-based strategies like phonics, early literacy programs, and 1:1 intensive tutoring.
- Hire more teachers and equip them with what they need to succeed: Expand programs like the Teacher Quality Partnership, the Supporting Effective Educator Development program, and the TEACH grant that fund and enhance teacher training and are helping to close the teacher workforce gap.
- Stand up to Big Money and fight private school voucher scams: Reject the voucher scams being pushed by billionaire mega-donors that defund public schools to subsidize private education for the wealthiest Americans.
- Secure universal early childhood education and affordable childcare: Establish universal Pre-K for every 3- and 4-year-old, make strong investments in childcare for children under 3, and protect Head Start.
- Support special education students: Protect federal oversight that ensures special education students receive the funding and support they need to be successful.
- Set students on career paths: Start students on flexible career paths in middle and high school by improving junior college and Career and Technical Education programs.
- Prioritize student health so kids can learn in the classroom: Expand the National School Lunch and School Breakfast programs (because no student can learn on an empty stomach!) and add more counselors to ensure kids have the mental health resources and other support they need in school.
- Ensure AI is a benefit, not a harm, in the classroom: Establish recommended guidelines that can help states and schools safely use AI in the classroom in ways that enhance — rather than hinder — learning opportunities and educational outcomes.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Overhauled Texas’s school finance system and invested over $6.5 billion into public schools for teacher pay raises, educator training, new literacy and math proficiency initiatives, and more.
- Led the fight against private school vouchers that are defunding Texas’ neighborhood public schools.
- Increased access to early childhood education by expanding Pre-K partnerships with quality child care providers and lowering costs by providing property tax relief for child care centers.
- Lowered higher education costs by establishing tuition and fee exemptions and a public junior college state finance program .
- Passed the first-ever cap on Pre-K class sizes to reduce student-to-teacher ratios and give our youngest students more individualized attention.
- Prioritized mental health in schools by opening up millions of dollars in mental health resources for students and improving trainings for educators on mental health and substance abuse.
- Equipped every public school with Narcan to fight the teen overdose crisis.
- Improved school safety in Texas by increasing child care providers’ access to active shooter and other safety trainings .
- Supported retired teachers by voting to provide a “13th check” — a supplemental payment on top of their retirement benefits.

pages.title: James Talarico on Public Safety, Guns & Justice
pages.text:
## Public Safety & Justice
Safe Neighborhoods for Every Texan
Every Texan deserves a safe neighborhood. James Talarico will give law enforcement the resources it needs, protect the Second Amendment while passing universal background checks, and stop crime before it happens.
We all deserve to live in a safe neighborhood. And as your Senator, your safety will always be my top priority.
Public safety means ensuring law enforcement has the resources to investigate and prosecute crime. It means passing commonsense gun safety laws to keep firearms out of the hands of criminals. And it means listening to police chiefs when they tell us we will all be safer when we fund programs like mental health care, housing support, addiction treatment, and youth services to prevent crime before it happens.
Unfortunately, when it comes to public safety issues, we’re often too busy talking past each other instead of working together on solutions. But here’s what gives me hope in what we can achieve if we start finding common ground:
In my first term as a state legislator, a constituent named John sent me an angry message. He accused me of being a “Democrat who wants to take away everyone’s guns.” Instead of getting into a fight online, I asked him to meet in person over coffee — and he actually accepted.
We all deserve to live in a safe neighborhood. And as your Senator, our safety will always be my top priority.
John turned out to be a good guy; he even brought his wife and kids. He was a gun enthusiast and a certified NRA safety officer. And the more we talked, the more we realized we shared something important: we both care deeply about safety. I talked about how many of my constituents had been victims of gun violence. He talked about how responsible gun owners are often the biggest advocates for safety.
Once we were actually listening to each other, we found real consensus — on background checks and other common-sense steps to keep guns out of the hands of felons, domestic abusers, and anyone who’s a threat to themselves or others.
When we sit down as neighbors instead of opponents, we discover we’re fighting for the same thing: safe schools, safe streets, safe communities. And when every Texan feels safe, every Texan can thrive.
A few weeks ago, a constituent named John sent me an angry message about guns. He’s a dues-paying member of the NRA and an avid gun enthusiast. But instead of fighting online, we decided to meet for coffee and listen to each other… (1/3) pic.twitter.com/iWRh4r7YHJ
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) September 18, 2019

Now his school district requires Narcan—an overdose reversal medication—on each campus. It's already saved 5 lives.

“I worked with Javier's family to pass Javier Ambler's Law, which bans reality TV policing in the state of Texas…
Do not believe anything I say, believe what… pic.twitter.com/En60rq6ZMy
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) December 14, 2025
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Strengthen law enforcement agencies: Ensure law enforcement agencies at the federal, state, and local level have the resources necessary to investigate and prosecute criminals, and support strong investments in police training, oversight, and accountability.
- Support survivors of crime: Expand funding for the Victims of Crime Act and Violence Against Women Act to better support survivors with financial, legal, housing, and counseling support.
- Protect the Second Amendment while protecting our neighbors from gun violence: Establish universal background checks for gun sales, prioritize the prosecution of firearms traffickers who are illegally flooding our communities with guns that get into the hands of criminals, require firearms to be securely stored around children in the home, and raise the age to purchase semi-automatic rifles with certain military-style features like high-capacity magazines.
- Legalize regulated marijuana for adults: Ensure law enforcement is focused on going after violent crime and not low-level marijuana offenses, expunge criminal arrest records related to marijuana use, and regulate and impose taxes on its sale to support public safety and health programs.
- Invest in strong reentry programs: Invest in job training, housing, and treatment that reduce recidivism and provide formerly incarcerated people with the tools they need to successfully rejoin their communities
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Honored the service of our law enforcement officers with the first bill I ever passed as a state legislator, which renamed the major highway in my district after a fallen officer — Chris Kelley — who gave his life in service to our community.
- Supported survivors of crime by creating the Sexual Assault Survivors’ Task Force , strengthening domestic violence protective orders , providing housing and treatment grants for human trafficking victims, and extending the statute of limitations for sexual assault offenses.
- Banned reality TV policing in Texas : After a constituent of mine was murdered by police on “Live PD” for having his brights on, I passed Javier Ambler’s Law to ban reality TV policing that encourages violent encounters to boost TV ratings.
- Supported commonsense gun violence prevention by increasing penalties for mass shooting perpetrators and opposing legislation allowing for the permitless carry of firearms in Texas.
- Strengthened rehabilitation and reentry programs by passing a law to provide every incarcerated minor the opportunity to graduate with a high school diploma .
- Held criminals accountable by voting for legislation requiring drunk drivers to pay restitution to a child whose parent they killed , preventing animal abusers from possessing animals after their conviction , and addressing the use of AI to create sexually explicit images of a minor.
- Improved safety within educational settings by increasing child care providers’ access to active shooter and other safety trainings.

pages.title: James Talarico on Rural Texas, Farms & Ranches
pages.text:
## Rural Investment
Hospitals, Schools, Water, and Broadband for Rural Texas
Rural Texas built this state, but voucher scams are draining its public schools and data centers are taking over its farmland. James Talarico will protect rural schools, bring high-speed internet and clean water to every corner of the state, and stand with the farmers and ranchers who feed Texas, so young people can build a life close to home.
My family is from rural Texas – from the small towns and agricultural communities that built this great state.
Every Texas community contributes to this state’s success. But not every community is being given the opportunity to share in it. Our leaders have turned their backs on rural Texas — failing to keep rural hospitals from shuttering, stand up to the private school voucher scams that are siphoning off funding from rural public schools, or make the basic investments needed to ensure that rural businesses can thrive and young people can find a job close to home.
I’m going to keep showing up and listening to rural Texans. Because I’m going to be a Senator for every Texan.
And we have to do better by our Texas farmers and ranchers, who produce the food and fiber that power economies in every corner of our state and country. The agriculture sector employs one out of every seven Texans — and they shouldn’t have to give up farms that their parents and grandparents tended because of our government’s failures.
I’m going to keep showing up and listening to rural Texans. Because I’m going to be a Senator for every Texan.
There’s always enough money for bombs, bailouts, and billionaire tax breaks — but never enough to fix basic infrastructure.
Wichita Falls hasn’t voted for a Democrat in nearly 40 years.
But that didn’t stop a huge crowd from showing up for @JamesTalarico. pic.twitter.com/hL4phHF25x
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) November 20, 2025
Amarillo is one of the reddest towns in Texas.
But I showed up because our campaign is not writing off any community.
It was standing room only. pic.twitter.com/biiJVpAvIa
— James Talarico (@jamestalarico) November 6, 2025
Huge crowd for @jamestalarico in deep red San Angelo, TX!
This county hasn’t voted for a Democrat since LBJ, but they showed up for Talarico. pic.twitter.com/ThAK6fztrk
— Team Talarico (@TeamTalaricoHQ) October 13, 2025
Great crowd for @jamestalarico in the small town of Hillsboro, TX!
The organizers said it was the biggest crowd they’ve ever seen at a political event in deep-red Hillsboro.
This is how we win Texas. pic.twitter.com/89YawurAAF
— Antonio Esparza (@AntonioAEsparza) August 24, 2025
## My Priorities in the U.S. Senate
- Repeal policies that are hurting Texas farmers and ranchers: Oppose new foreign beef imports like the Argentina buyout and cuts to essential USDA programs that protect our herd from pests like the New World Screwworm, and remove the Trump Administration’s tariffs on farm inputs like equipment and fertilizer that are making Texas agricultural production more expensive — as well as those on produce that have sparked retaliatory tariffs on key agricultural exports.
- Save rural hospitals: Prioritize recruiting and retaining rural healthcare workers, improve Medicaid and Medicare reimbursement rates to more swiftly deliver payments to hospitals, and make sure rural hospitals have the funding they need to continue to serve as vital employers and health care providers.
- Reject private school voucher scams: Oppose the federal voucher scam being pushed by billionaires like Betsy DeVos — which would defund public schools to subsidize private education for the wealthy, disproportionately harming rural areas where public schools are the community’s largest employer.
- Help young people stay and contribute to their hometowns: Dedicate technical support toward economic and community development activities that address gaps in job opportunities, child care, internet connectivity, and housing that are pushing many young families out of rural communities.
- Expand access to high-speed internet: Increase funding dedicated to expanding high-speed internet access across Texas to meet the federal government’s original $3.3 billion commitment to our state.
- Support a strong agricultural workforce: Expand workforce development to train new workers in the industry, support farmer-to-farmer programs, and help farmers and ranchers lower food costs for Americans by responsibly hiring migrant workers when they can’t find Americans to fill their jobs — including by simplifying the H-2A visa program application and ensuring strong labor standards on those visas so that employers do not game the system to displace American workers and suppress their wages.
- Expand water access: Make it easier for rural communities to access low-interest loans and grants for constructing or upgrading water systems.
## My Track Record in the Texas Legislature
- Protected rural hospitals by approving the establishment of the State Office of Rural Hospital Finance and the Texas Rural Hospital Officers Academy.
- Led the fight against private school vouchers that are defunding rural public schools to subsidize private education for the wealthy.
- Supported farmers and ranchers by growing the agriculture grant program and establishing a financial assistance program dedicated to pest and disease control .
